pinev: The papers put the 800-acre farm 'two miles from' Webster City next to the county poor farm. The 1918 Hamilton atlas (Cass Twp p.18) shows the County Home 80 at the S edge of sec 34 T89N R25W, about 2 mi NE of Webster City (BLM PLSS). The pin is on the County Home, and the r1500 ring covers 800 acres around it. By 1918 no adjoining land was in the family's name, and it's not proven the County Home was on the same site in 1898.
set.t: Find the family's 800 acres on an 1880s-1890s Hamilton plat (land around the County Home, sec 34 T89N R25W and neighbours). Private: permission.
